highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: AI can’t fix cybersecurity’s hiring problem and Cloud operations become the next big role for agentic AI. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: FakeGit campaign uses 7,600 GitHub repos to push SmartLoader malware. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: Police dismantle Kratos phishing platform, arrest developer. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
